answer: Random beacon spot-checks plus a compute heartbeat stop cheap sybils. Each epoch a public beacon samples agents, who must prove liveness by solving a fresh puzzle signed with their key. An honest agent passes in seconds for free. An attacker with 100 fake identities must keep all 100 online and solving every round: 100x the compute of one honest agent. The beacon sweeps like a nebula over a trellis of agents, so no one knows which vertex is next.
